questions.prompt: According to WHO, roughly how many people died in road traffic crashes worldwide in 2025?
questions.insight: That is 21% fewer deaths than in 2011, even though more than a billion vehicles have been added to the world's roads.

questions.prompt: In 2024, what share of the world's urban population lived in slums or slum-like conditions (informal settlements or inadequate housing), according to the UN SDG indicator 11.1.1?
questions.insight: About 1.16 billion urban residents lived in slums or informal settlements in 2024, and the total keeps rising as cities grow.

questions.prompt: How much did the world spend on the military in 2025, in trillions of current US dollars, according to SIPRI?
questions.insight: At 2.5% of world GDP, military spending in 2025 was at its highest share since 2009.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's electricity was generated by hydropower in 2025, according to Ember?
questions.insight: Hydropower is still the world's largest source of renewable electricity, ahead of wind and solar.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's population is covered by a 5G mobile network, according to ITU estimates for 2025?
questions.insight: 5G reaches 84% of people in high-income countries but only 4% in low-income countries.
